items.title: Agent swarms are the next scaling frontier for AI
items.text: Agent swarms are the next scaling frontier for AI. For years, we’ve scaled intelligence by training larger models and giving them more time to think. But there’s another dimension: running many agents in parallel, exploring different approaches, challenging each other, and working together on solutions that no single agent could easily discover. OpenAI has already demonstrated the potential of this approach with breakthroughs in mathematics. Until now, experimenting with agent swarms yourself required building complicated orchestration infrastructure. Starting today on Replit, spinning up a swarm of agents is just one prompt away. Excited to see what people discover when we make collective...
